subject: Barry shared KB
object: community solution lessons as anonymized JSONL source records that are reviewed through Git before publication

subject: Shared KB snapshots
object: manifest, manifest signature, lesson JSONL, revocation JSONL, and search index files for static Cloudflare Pages or R2 distribution

subject: Shared KB search
object: trusted lessons while allowing reviewed lessons only through an explicit include-reviewed option

subject: Shared KB validation
object: revealing file paths, email addresses, secret-looking tokens, malformed records, and duplicate lesson IDs before publication

subject: Shared KB contribution
object: local-only mode so Barry does not send shared KB contributions unless the user explicitly opts in

subject: Shared KB contribution mode
object: .barry-cache/config.json as repo-local user config with local_only, preview_only, or share_enabled values

subject: barry-cache kb sharing
object: shared KB contribution status and set commands using local-only, preview-only, and share-enabled CLI mode names

subject: Remote shared KB search
object: share-enabled contribution mode, while local shared KB snapshot search remains available in every mode

subject: Barry Brain server
object: a vendor-neutral HTTP contract (healthz, intake, search, snapshot, attest, lesson) for the distributed shared KB, reusing shared-kb schema, validation, redaction, and Ed25519 signing

subject: Barry Brain core
object: a portable Web Fetch API handler plus a BrainStore persistence interface so the same code can run on multiple runtimes and storage backends

subject: Brain v1
object: a single Docker container backed by bun:sqlite with no external services and no new runtime dependencies

subject: Each Brain
object: its own Ed25519 keypair whose public-key fingerprint clients pin to verify snapshot signatures end-to-end without a central authority

subject: Brain trust policy
object: company mode that makes submitted lessons usable immediately, while global mode stores submissions as reviewed pending a later staged-maturation engine

subject: Brain conformance suite
object: that any deployment satisfies the vendor-neutral Brain contract via the barry-brain conformance command
